subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the RFC’s experimental core Claw lifecycle and land this consented agent/root-provenance slice after its read-only base?
rationale: Implementation review can assess the safety of this slice, but automation cannot decide whether OpenClaw should adopt a new mutating CLI, manifest lifecycle, and durable provenance contract while the RFC and base remain open.

options.title: Sponsor and land sequentially
options.body: Approve the product direction, finish the read-only base review, resolve exact-head checks, and then land this mutation slice with its recovery contract intact.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC and implementation stack open while maintainers narrow the lifecycle, ownership, or recovery semantics.

options.title: Decline the core lifecycle
options.body: Close the implementation stack if Claws should not become a core OpenClaw product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and land sequentially
recommendation.body: Approve the product direction, finish the read-only base review, resolve exact-head checks, and then land this mutation slice with its recovery contract intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared-state ownership boundary and adjacent core lifecycle decisions.
